abstract: Controlled trophoblast invasion is a key process during human placentation and a prerequisite for successful pregnancy. Progesterone is one of the factors to regulate trophoblast invasiveness. Progesterone-induced blocking factor (PIBF) is a progesterone-induced molecule expressed by the trophoblast, and also by tumors. The distribution of PIBF within the first-trimester decidua coincides with sites of trophoblast invasion. Another molecule that has been implicated in the control of trophoblast invasiveness is placental leptin. Leptin inhibits the secretion of progesterone by cytotrophoblast. The aim of this work was to investigate the possible interaction of PIBF and leptins in regulating trophoblast invasion. Paraffin-embedded sections from normal first-trimester placentae, partial moles, complete moles, and choriocarcinomas were reacted with PIBF, leptin, and leptin receptor specific antibodies. PIBF-deficient trophoblast cells were generated using siRNA and leptin receptor was detected on Western blot analysis. The lysates of PIBF-treated cells were used for detecting leptin expression in a protein array. PIBF was expressed in both normal first-trimester villous trophoblast and in partial mole. Compared with this, PIBF expression was markedly decreased in complete mole and absent in choriocarcinoma. Neither leptinR nor leptin were detected in partial mole, whereas both of these molecules were present in complete mole and choriocarcinoma. Leptin receptor expression was upregulated in PIBF-deficient cells, while leptin expression was decreased in PIBF-treated cells. These data suggest that PIBF affects the expression of leptin and its receptor, and that PIBF expression is inversely related to trophoblast invasiveness.
abstract_ja: プロゲステロン誘導性ブロッキング因子(PIBF)は、栄養膜により発現され、腫瘍でも発現するプロゲステロン誘導性分子である。PIBFが妊娠初期の脱落膜において分布する部位は、栄養膜浸潤が生じる部位と一致する。栄養膜浸潤能の制御に関与するもう1つの分子は胎盤レプチンである。レプチンは栄養膜細胞によるプロゲステロン分泌を抑制する。本研究の目的は、栄養膜浸潤の制御におけるPIBFとレプチンの相互作用の可能性を検討することであった。正常な妊娠初期胎盤、部分胞状奇胎、全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌のパラフィン包埋切片を、PIBF、レプチン、レプチン受容体特異的抗体で染色した。siRNAを用いてPIBF欠損栄養膜細胞を作製し、レプチン受容体をウェスタンブロット法で検出した。PIBF処理細胞の溶解物をタンパク質アレイに用いてレプチン発現を検出した。PIBFは正常な妊娠初期の絨毛栄養膜と部分胞状奇胎で発現していた。これと比較して、PIBF発現は全胞状奇胎で顕著に低下し、絨毛癌では消失していた。レプチンもレプチン受容体も部分胞状奇胎では検出されなかったが、全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌ではいずれも存在していた。PIBF欠損細胞ではレプチン受容体の発現が上昇し、PIBF処理細胞ではレプチン発現が低下した。これらのデータは、PIBFがレプチンとその受容体の発現に影響を与えること、およびPIBF発現が栄養膜浸潤能と逆相関することを示唆する。
